facts.label: Year Michelin and RATP ran the world's first metro on tyres
Trips on the Montreal metro so far, over

references.what: a clean 3D render of a metro car's inside: seats, poles, blue clay passengers, no words

thumbnail.pattern: the reference sells the train itself as a clean 3D render with no words; ours keeps the train big and real in 3D but shows the tyre under it, with three words asking the question

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: This Paris Metro train runs on rubber tyres.

place: a dark Paris Metro tunnel, the train coming at the camera
under the train, at the wheels

moments.what: the train's headlights flare as it roars out of the tunnel toward the camera
the yellow M sign over the tunnel mouth lights up
the train's front fills the frame, tunnel lamps streaking past
cut low under the car: a fat black rubber tyre spins on a flat track, a label writes on
the tyre's tread blurs, the second tyre behind it spins too

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Paris first tried it in {fact1}. So what keeps it on the track?

params.place: a tiled Paris Metro station platform, the train standing at it

moments.what: the camera drifts along the white tiled wall past the waiting train
an enamel plaque on the wall writes on the year
the plaque's year pulses and the train's lights brighten
the yellow M sign on the wall lights up
the train pulls away from the platform
the camera drops down over the platform edge to the track
the two flat running tracks light up amber, a label writes on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Under each car, fat tyres roll on two flat running tracks. They carry the weight and drive the train.

params.place: inside the car's underside, the body turned see-through over the bogie

moments.what: the car body fades to glass, the bogie underneath lit
the bogie's frame glows cyan
the camera pushes in on the four black tyres
the tyres start to turn, the track sliding past
the two flat running tracks glow amber under them, a label writes on
the running tracks run off into the tunnel in light
weight arrows press down from the car onto each tyre
the arrows pulse
a motor on the axle glows and the tyres spin faster
the whole bogie surges forward

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: But a tyre can't steer itself. So small sideways wheels press on a guide bar at each side.

params.place: beside the bogie on a curve of track, looking down at the guide bar

moments.what: the bogie rolls along its track, seen from above
the front tyre glows
the bogie drifts sideways off its line, a red arrow shows it heading off the track
it slides back onto the line, the arrow fades
small flat wheels pop out at the bogie's four corners, the camera close on one
they spin on their sides, a label writes on
all four flash as they reach out
they press on a steel bar along the track, a cyan contact flash
the guide bar lights up along its length, a label writes on
the bogie rolls on dead straight between the lit bars
the camera pulls up: a guide bar on each side, the bogie turning between them

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Why the trouble? Rubber grips better than steel, so the train speeds up and brakes harder, and runs quieter.

params.place: a stretch of tunnel between two stations, seen from the side

moments.what: two halves of a lit bench: a steel wheel on a rail and a rubber tyre on a flat track
both wheels turn, a label names the rubber one
the camera pushes in on the tyre's contact patch
the tyre squashes on the track, its wide contact patch glowing amber, a label writes on: grip
the steel wheel's tiny contact point glows and it slips, spinning in place: slip
cut wide: a short tunnel between two lit platforms, the train shoots out of the far one, speed streaks behind it
it brakes hard into the near station, the brakes glowing red
it stops right at the platform
sound rings around the wheels shrink and fade

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And right beside every tyre, on the same axle, sits a steel train wheel, just above an ordinary rail.

params.place: behind the tyre, down between it and the track

moments.what: the lights dim to one spot on the tyre
the camera slides round behind the tyre
the tyre turns see-through
the see-through tyre's rim flashes
the hub at the axle's end glows cyan
the axle glows along its length
a dark wheel shape shows beside the tyre on the axle
it lights up amber: a steel train wheel with a flange
a label writes on: steel wheel
the camera drops to the gap: a bright bracket between the wheel and the rail
an ordinary rail glows under it, running along inside the flat track
the camera pulls back: steel wheels and rails all along the bogie

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: If a tyre goes flat, that wheel drops onto the rail and the train rolls on. A steel train, hiding inside a rubber one.

place: the flat tyre and the rail, close
the tunnel, the whole train seen through

moments.what: a nail glints in the tyre's tread
air hisses out in a puff
the tyre sags flat on the track
the steel wheel drops onto the rail, sparks fly
the rail glows where the wheel lands
the train rolls on, the steel wheel turning on its rail
the camera pulls back: the whole train turns see-through, every steel wheel glowing amber
the steel wheels light up one after another down the train
the rubber tyres glow back on around the steel wheels

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Montreal built its whole metro this way in {fact2}, and it has carried over {fact3} trips. Back in Paris, the tyres keep rolling.

place: a Montreal Metro station with a blue train

moments.what: a blue-banded Montreal train glides into a bare concrete station under its blue sign
a plaque on the station wall writes on the year
the network's coloured lines draw on along the wall
the lines finish drawing
the train's tyres glow under it
the plaque's year pulses bright
the Montreal sign flashes and the train's tyres glow
the network map's lines flash
the departures board lights up beside it
a departures board counts up the trips
the board's figure lands, the train pulls out
cut to the dark Paris tunnel, headlights far off
the Metro sign lights over the tunnel mouth
the train comes on, its tyres turning, headlights flaring
the camera settles on the first frame of the video
